_comment: Daily rotating news tips. Pick deterministic by date hash. Each item shown roughly once every N days. Mix store-promo, recipe tip, festival reminder, local Saskatoon flavor, farm-game tip.

items.title_en: 🥬 This week: Bok Choy on sale
items.body_zh: 新鲜上海青本周到货充足，店里 $1.49/lb，比平时便宜 30%。游戏里也能种它哦。
items.body_en: Fresh bok choy is in stock this week at $1.49/lb, 30% off. You can also grow it in the game!

items.body_zh: 热锅冷油下蒜末爆香，下上海青大火快炒 90 秒，几滴生抽，出锅。
items.body_en: Heat oil, sizzle garlic, toss in bok choy on high heat for 90 seconds, splash of soy sauce, done.

items.body_zh: 今天 -25°C 别忘了多穿，店里有热豆浆和煲汤料包，回家煲一锅暖身。
items.body_en: It's -25°C today — bundle up. The store has hot soy milk and soup base kits to warm up at home.

items.body_zh: 韭菜种一次能割 3 次！每次再长只要 1 小时，超划算。
items.body_en: Chinese chives can be harvested 3 times from one planting — regrow only 1 hour each. Best deal!

items.body_zh: 节日窗口开放时，水仙花、年橘等限定作物会出现在种子店。
items.body_en: When the festival window opens, limited crops like narcissus and kumquat will show up in the shop.

items.body_zh: 每次收获有 1% 概率掉落金疙瘩，最高 +500 东方积分。
items.body_en: Every harvest has a 1% chance to drop a Golden Nugget, up to +500 EP!

items.body_zh: 每周六周日积分双倍！集中在周末收获能拿更多。
items.body_en: Every Saturday and Sunday, EP rewards are doubled! Stockpile harvests for the weekend.

items.body_zh: 用东方积分换加速券、装饰品、扩展地块，让农场更丰富。
items.body_en: Spend EP on acceleration tickets, decorations, and plot expansions — make your farm yours.

items.body_zh: 番茄切块 + 鸡蛋打散，先炒蛋盛出，再炒番茄，最后合炒。出锅前撒葱花。
items.body_en: Cube tomatoes, beat eggs. Scramble eggs first, set aside. Stir-fry tomatoes, combine, garnish with scallion.

items.body_zh: 133-412 Willowgrove Square, Saskatoon. 周一至周六 10am-6:30pm。
